title: Outreach history and in-app call button
human_decisions: Past SMS and calls are shown as prepared frontend history; SMS appears active but manual send is disabled until the owner wires it.

The call button needs no token; a DEMO_CALL_BUTTON switch replaces per-call arming. The owner accepts the capped risk while it is on and will switch it off and revoke the operator token after the demo.
No transcript parsing for the demo.
No provider names in the UI.
open_items: Set DEMO_CALL_BUTTON=true on Railway for demo day, then false afterwards.
Wire live SMS after carrier registration.
